submitted_sql: SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.invoice i WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY i.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, i.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;
validated_sql: SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.invoice AS i WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY i.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, i.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1
